attempts.summary: On node1, built an LVM-backed XFS filesystem for /srv/data (loop-backed VG since the root disk had no free partition/LVM/btrfs support), populated baseline application data, took an LVM snapshot, modified the data (edited config, appended to data.db, deleted a log file, added a junk file), then restored the exact snapshot content via lvconvert --merge and verified SHA256 checksums matched the baseline exactly. Made the setup persistent via a systemd oneshot unit (srv-data-loop.service) + fstab entry. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the loop device, LVM VG, /srv/data mount, and data checksums all recovered automatically post-reboot.
